title.suggested: Tom Allen Introduces Bauer-Heygster Wrestling Match

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen introduced Prof. Bauer and Herr Heygster at their $250-a-side wrestling match at the Temple, which Bauer won, and announced a silver belt for Bauer.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The St. Louis Republican, Sunday Morning, April 9, 1876, page 10. Match was 'last evening' (April 8).

facts.fact: Allen introduced the wrestlers and acted as announcer at the Bauer-Heygster wrestling match at the Temple, St. Louis, announcing a silver belt for Bauer as champion Graeco-Roman wrestler of America
